spec_ref: 05-model-router/spec.md §1.6, §4; Qafiya v1.1 §8 layout; chained history v1.3
invariants: append-only: no record is ever modified or removed
gate_trace has exactly one entry per gate in policy.gates.order
est_tokens_in holds the per-variant input estimate for EVERY variant considered, so gate 3 stays replayable when the prompt text is deliberately not stored (spec §6.1 boundary)
privacy_class=private implies prompt_text is null and response_text is null (spec §12.4)
privacy_class=private implies chosen.locus != cloud — 0 violations, hard fail (spec §7.7)
outcome=refused implies refusal_reason is non-null and names the gate that emptied the set
every attempts[] entry carries provider-metered actuals, never estimates
attempts[] records the full try chain: a retried call lists each try's usage, so a retry can never double-count silently (RC-4.2)
health_snapshot pins the circuit-breaker state the decision saw, so gate replay is exact even though health is runtime state (RC-4.3)
registry_provenance marks locus, privacy_class and price as user-declared; the decision never records a declaration as a measurement (RC-1.3)
outcome=refused with refusal_reason=all_connections_failed means every feasible connection failed at call time and the failure chain is in attempts[] (RC-4.10)
identical frozen inputs produce a byte-identical decision record (spec §2.7) — health_snapshot and attempt timing excepted, which is why the replay pins them
a private/confidential request whose chosen locus is cloud always carries privacy_warning — the router records the user's choice, it does not veto it (owner override 2026-10-25)
a PUBLIC verdict that was checked by a verifier records the verdict, whether it changed the class, and its cost; a failed verification demotes to confidential, never back to public (spec §19)
classifier_mode=trust_user means NO classification was performed: privacy_class is public by construction, not by analysis, and every decision under that mode says so
